(Legislative Department) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 25th October, 2025 S.O. 4892(E).— In pursuance of section 67 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the following declaration containing the name of the candidate elected to fill the seat in the Council of States of one member, namely, Shri Mir Mohammad Fayaz, who retired on the 10th February, 2021 on the expiration of his term of office, is published for general information:– Declaration Election to the Council of States by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of the Union territory of Jammu and Kashmir. “In pursuance of the provisions contained in section 66 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, read with clause (a) of sub-rule (1) of rule 84 of the Conduct of Election Rules, 1961, I declare that:– Chowdry Mohammad Ramzan, H.No. 118, Handwara, Kupwara (Sponsored by J&K National Conference) has been duly elected to fill a seat in that House caused due to the retirement of Shri Mir Mohammad Fayaz on 10th February, 2021 on the expiration of his term of office. Place : Jammu Sd- Dated: 24/10/2025 Returning Officer”. [F.No.H.11024/9/2025-Leg.II] AKALI V. KONGHAY, Jt.
